edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production as set forth below. Specific responses and objections must be stated for each request.
edits.name: Preliminary statement

edits.text: 1. PRIVILEGE AND PROTECTION. Defendant will not produce material protected by the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, or another applicable protection. Any assertion of privilege or protection will be identified in the applicable request-specific response, with information supporting the assertion provided as required by governing rules or court order.
edits.name: Privilege and protection

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION. For each request, Defendant will state whether responsive, non-privileged documents will be produced and whether any responsive material is being withheld on the basis of an objection. The scope, timing, and format of production will be specified in the request-specific responses or an agreed production protocol.
edits.name: Production

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent required by governing rules or court order, Defendant will provide a privilege log for responsive material withheld on grounds of privilege or protection.

edits.text: 4. SUPPLEMENTATION. Defendant will supplement or correct these responses as required by governing rules or court order.

edits.text: Defendant's Response to Requests for Production — DRAFT FOR COUNSEL REVIEW; NOT FOR SERVICE

PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. This draft is an incomplete framework for Defendant's responses to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production, not a completed discovery response. Before service, reproduce and answer each request separately, stating any specific objection and its grounds, whether responsive material is withheld on that basis, and the confirmed scope, format, and timing of production. This preliminary statement does not assert general objections or substitute for request-specific responses.

REQUIRED BEFORE SERVICE: Obtain the actual requests and confirm service details, governing rules and orders, and applicable deadlines. Confer with the client concerning custodians, sources, search parameters, preservation, collection and review status, and feasible production dates. For each request, provide a complete response stating specific objections, withholding status, definite production scope and formats, and completion dates. Do not invent facts, dates, or objections. Obtain any necessary extension by agreement or court order rather than assuming one.
edits.name: Counsel review

edits.text: REQUIRED BEFORE SERVICE: Confirm applicable privilege-log requirements, any permissible exclusions or alternative procedures, and the log delivery deadline. Identify privilege assertions in the relevant request-specific responses and state a definite, verified log delivery date where required. Preserve the existing not-ready-for-service review note until all missing information and responses have been completed.
edits.name: Counsel review
